reference_face_index.description: Zero-based number of the face in the reference image.

target_face_index.description: Zero-based number of the face in the target to replace.

reference_image_url.description: Reference face image. The facial features from this image are carried onto the person in the video.

style.description: Finish applied to the swapped face: realistic keeps natural skin tone and texture, beautify smooths and brightens the skin, lossless holds on to the most facial detail.

video_url.description: Target video. The face of the person in this clip is the one that gets replaced.

image_url.description: Target image. The head of the person in this image is the one that gets replaced.

reference_image_url.description: Reference head image. The whole head, including hair and head shape, is transferred onto the target.

seed.description: Random seed; zero requests a random seed.

image_url.description: Photo whose background is removed. The main subject is kept and everything else becomes transparent.
The image to enlarge. Its framing and aspect ratio are kept; only the resolution goes up.

output_format.description: File type of the returned image. png is lossless but several times larger than jpeg.

resolution.description: Output size tier: a pixel budget of about 4 (2k), 17 (4k) or 67 (8k) megapixels, with the aspect ratio kept. A tier below the source's pixel count scales the image down. All three tiers cost the same.

image_url.description: Photo to clean up. The selected objects are removed and the space is filled to match the scene.

mask_url.description: Optional black-and-white mask the same size as the photo: white marks what to remove, black what to keep. Give this, prompt, or both.

output_format.description: File format of the returned image.

prompt.description: What to remove, in a few plain words with a position when there is more than one, e.g. "the wooden bench on the left". Give this, mask_url, or both.

resolution.description: Output tier: a pixel budget with the clip's aspect ratio kept, so an 832x480 clip at 1080p comes back at 1896x1094. Sets the per-second rate.

video_url.description: The clip to upscale, 3 to 60 seconds long. Length, motion and the audio track are kept; clips outside that range are rejected before any charge.

aspect_ratio.description: Shape of the finished image. The long edge is always 1536 pixels.

image_url.description: Photo to expand. It is set inside a larger frame and new scenery is painted around it.

output_format.description: File format of the returned image.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional output aspect ratio. Leave it empty to keep the shape of the photo.

image_url.description: The photo to process: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB.

output_format.description: File format of the returned image.

seed.description: Random seed for controlled comparisons.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional output aspect ratio. Leave it empty to keep the shape of the photo.

image_url.description: The person to re-pose, full body visible: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB.

output_format.description: File format of the returned image.

prompt.description: Optional extra direction added after the built-in pose instruction, e.g. to keep your own background or outfit.

reference_image_url.description: A photo of the pose to copy; only the pose is used. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional output aspect ratio. Leave it empty to keep the shape of the photo.

image_url.description: The photo to process: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB.

output_format.description: File format of the returned image.

clone_voice.description: Re-voice each speaker in a voice modelled on their own.

glossary.description: Names and phrases with a fixed translation, up to 100 pairs.

term.description: The word or phrase as it is spoken in the clip.

translation.description: How it should come out in the dub. Repeat the term to keep it untranslated.

keep_background_audio.description: Keep the original music and sound effects under the dub; off returns the translated voices only.

source_language.description: Language spoken in the clip. auto detects it; set it when there is music under the voice, a heavy accent or long pauses.

speaker_count.description: Number of people speaking, 1 to 4. Leave it out to detect it.

target_language.description: Language to dub into. It must differ from the language spoken in the clip.

video_url.description: Clip to translate, 1 second to 10 minutes. The picture is kept; the returned clip carries the dubbed audio. Billed per started minute of this clip.

aspect_ratio.description: Optional output aspect ratio. Leave it empty to keep the shape of the photo.

image_url.description: The photo to process: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB.

output_format.description: File format of the returned image.

prompt.description: The new light: source, direction, colour and hardness, e.g. "Relight the image with warm golden sunset light from a window on the left."

x-ui.placeholder: Relight the image with warm golden sunset light from a window on the left.

seed.description: Random seed for controlled comparisons.

audio_url.description: Speech that drives the lips, 3 to 60 seconds, MP3 or WAV. The video runs as long as this audio; files outside that range are rejected before any charge.

image_url.description: Portrait of the person who will speak. One clearly visible face, looking roughly at the camera, works best.

mask_url.description: Optional black-and-white mask the same size as the portrait, white over the person who should speak. Only needed when the portrait shows several people.

prompt.description: Optional note on expression or mood, such as calm or cheerful. Identity and setting come from the portrait.

seed.description: Random seed for controlled comparisons.

audio_url.description: New speech to sync, 3 to 60 seconds, MP3 or WAV. The result runs as long as this audio; files outside that range are rejected before any charge.

video_url.description: Clip whose mouth movement is replaced. One clearly visible face works best; a clip shorter than the audio is looped to cover it.

duration_seconds.description: Seconds of sound to generate, from 1 to 30. The returned clip is cut to this length and these seconds are billed.

guidance_scale.description: How closely the sound follows the description, from 0 to 20.

ignore_visual_semantics.description: Choose the sounds from the prompt alone instead of from what the picture shows; timing still follows the motion.

negative_prompt.description: Sounds to keep out, such as music or speech.

prompt.description: The sounds you want, as a short list. If omitted, a general request for sounds that match the on-screen action is used.

steps.description: Refinement passes, from 4 to 50. More passes take longer.

video_url.description: Clip to add sound to. The picture is kept; the returned clip carries the generated sound as its audio.
